title: stk handover open <service> --json
description: What `stk handover open <service> --json` prints on stdout once the envelope read from stdin is opened and stored. Written from supertoolkit internal/setup/headless.go (`map[string]any{"service": name, "stored": true}`). AgentPod's node-agent reads only `stored` and requires it true (stkclient.go, HandoverOpen). On failure stk exits non-zero and writes `stk: <message>` to stderr; that text and the exit code are not part of this contract (phase 4, ruling 4).

service.description: The service the credential was stored for.

stored.description: Always true: a failure prints no JSON.
